verdict.rationale: Rollbar's docs portal has an "All OpenAPI Files" page (docs.rollbar.com/openapi) that links a downloadable OpenAPI 3.1.0 document for api.rollbar.com, covering Item, Occurrence, Metrics and Deploy resources. The probe's 404s only show the spec is not at conventional well-known paths; they do not contradict the documented download. missing for 10: discoverability at standard paths (/openapi.json or .well-known), independent or hands-on confirmation that the spec is complete and current against the live REST API.
